reference: NeuraSearch is a local self-correcting AI research assistant that runs 100% locally using Llama 3.3 and LangGraph.
HyDE generates a hypothetical ideal answer first, then embeds that answer and uses it for similarity search instead of the raw question.
Hybrid retrieval runs vector similarity search and BM25 keyword search in parallel, then merges the results using Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
